name: Oil (Brent)
summary: Brent near $94 after a 20% weekly fall, but Alert holds while Hormuz stays largely shut
state: Brent was near $94 early on 5 Nov, 20% lower on the week and 10% lower on the month, a price in the Watch band (Yahoo Finance); oil fell sharply on 4 Nov after the US midterms and on hopes for US–Iran talks (TheStreet). Alert is kept on the physical outage: Hormuz remains largely closed, Iran called the US reply to its reopening plan unconvincing on 3 Nov, and the IRGC claimed four tankers hit mines on 4 Nov (Al Jazeera).
for_you: Fuel and transport costs remain exposed to Gulf disruption, and prices can swing sharply on news from the talks.
rubric_hit: Major physical supply outage (Hormuz largely shut) = Alert; price $94 alone in Watch band
basis_detail: raised above the data floor on reported events

sources.title: Al Jazeera — Iran says US reply to Hormuz plan 'unconvincing'; Trump confirms strikes

why: Oil feeds inflation, transport and household budgets; price spikes have preceded most post-war recessions.
drivers: OPEC+ output, Middle East supply risk, sanctions, demand, inventories, shipping disruption.

rubric.alert: Brent > $110, or 1-month change > +30%, or a major physical supply outage (> 2 mb/d).
